name: Sheraton Waikiki
insider_take: This iconic beachfront tower has been Waikiki's most recognizable landmark since 1971, offering unparalleled ocean views from its distinctive curved facade.
whats_special: The Sheraton Waikiki boasts the largest infinity pool in Waikiki, stretching toward Diamond Head with no visual barriers to the Pacific. Its prime location sits directly on world-famous Waikiki Beach, while the hotel's unique crescent shape ensures 80% of rooms feature stunning ocean views. The property also houses Hawaii's only beachfront Starbucks.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 25-30 for breathtaking sunrise views over Diamond Head crater, and visit the pool deck at sunset when the infinity pool reflects the golden hour perfectly.
dont_miss: The nightly cliff dive ceremony at nearby Black Rock (Pu'u Keka'a), just a 15-minute walk away, and the hotel's exclusive beach access to some of Waikiki's best surfing breaks. The rooftop RumFire restaurant offers 360-degree views of Honolulu's skyline and is perfect for spotting green flash sunsets.
pros: Prime beachfront location directly on Waikiki Beach with stunning ocean views
Iconic infinity edge pool and RumFire poolside bar create a lively resort atmosphere
Spacious, well-appointed rooms with panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and Diamond Head
Marriott Bonvoy Luminous benefits including exclusive perks and elite member rewards
Excellent on-site dining options including the renowned Kai Market restaurant
cons: High-volume resort with a large number of guests, which may feel busy during peak season
Daily resort fee applies, adding to the overall cost of the stay
Urban hotel setting means limited seclusion from the bustling Waikiki strip
